faq.q: What does a before and after product video show?
faq.a: It makes a short ad where one thing changes and the product stays. Grease can leave a stovetop while the camera stays in the same place.

faq.q: How do I make a before and after video from one photo?
faq.a: Upload the before photo and describe the after in a sentence. Read the line when the file comes back, then change the music before you export.

faq.q: Which products fit a before and after video?
faq.a: It fits shops with many small changes to show, like grease wiped off one stovetop, rather than one film for a whole month. TikTok can take a tall file, and Meta can take a square.

faq.q: What does a before and after clip cost?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. Pro is $35 for 300 credits, and Premium is $63 for 600. You see the number before it starts. If the video fails, the credits come back.

faq.q: Can the file run as an ad I paid for?
faq.a: Yes. Commercial use is part of a paid plan, and the download has no watermark. You still need rights to the photo you uploaded.

faq.q: Which video shapes can I download?
faq.a: You can download 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Use the tall file for TikTok, the square for Meta, or the wide file for a landscape placement. Reels can use the tall file too.

faq.q: Can every product in the catalog get a clip?
faq.a: Yes. Send a photo for each cleaner or product page, and you get a separate clip for each. Store software can request them through the API.

faq.q: Should we stop filming changes ourselves?
faq.a: No. Use this when you need many tests of one wipe, and keep a filmed piece when a flagship spot needs your own camera.

faq.q: Could TikTok or Meta turn the ad down?
faq.a: Maybe. Read TikTok and Meta rules before you spend. Add a label if a viewer might think a real buyer is reviewing the product. The person on screen is one of 53 AI actors.

definition.title: What Is a Before and After Product Video?
paras: The product stays in frame. What changes is one visible thing: grease across a stovetop, then that same stove wiped clean. You approve the change before the file goes out.
A wide file can sit where a landscape placement asks for one. A tall file can go to TikTok, and a square can go to Meta. You approve the line before any file leaves.

reasons.h2: Why Make a Before and After Product Video
reasons.lead: The shopper should see the change the product makes, in the same shot.

items.t: Show the Dry Half and the Cream
items.d: A cream ad should show the same hand, dry on one side and moisturized on the other, with the jar in frame. The line has to name that cream, and it has to be the cream you uploaded.
items.alt: The same adult hand: dry flaky skin on the left half, a soft moisturized look on the right half, with a plain white cream jar.

items.t: Show the Pills, Then the Smooth Knit
items.d: The camel sweater shows pills on one half and a smooth knit on the other, with the fabric shaver in frame. A tall file can go to TikTok, and a square can go to Meta, without a second cut.
items.alt: The same camel knit sweater: pills on the left half, a smooth surface on the right half, with a plain sage electric fabric shaver.

items.t: Test Different Voice Tones
items.d: Two voice tones let you test the same garlic-press ad without booking a second shoot.
items.alt: Same wood cutting board: whole garlic and skins on the left, pressed garlic and a stainless garlic press on the right.
